title: Phil Schaap and the West End
summary: He returns to playing at the West End in 1975.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, I'd better. Getting back to my activities as a pianist, Phil Schaap, in 1975, I believe it was, asked me to

come over to the West End. That's another re-entry into the music world. I went back into it again, after, you know, being involved in the problems in Harlem. And I went back to the West End and I predicted that that place would become, you know, one of the real musical arenas in America, you know, and that people...people will have an opportunity to enjoy...that's the nearest thing to real jazz. I'm not talking about the modern emporiums and all that, I'm talking about...that's the nearest here. thing to jazz around/ Now there may be some other places, but I don't know them.
No. The surprising...well....... maybe not is that it's right near Columbia University and the audiences are, I guess, mostly made up of college kids and they seem to like it.
